# NKY Crawl Space Pros

## About
NKY Crawl Space Pros repairs crawl spaces for homes in Cincinnati & Northern Kentucky (Boone, Kenton, and Campbell counties): encapsulation, waterproofing, mold remediation, and structural repairs. Free inspections with written estimates: (714) 494-9486.

## Services
- Crawl space encapsulation and vapor barriers, most homes done in 1-2 days
- Crawl space waterproofing: sump pumps, drainage, and moisture barriers
- Crawl space mold remediation

## Service Areas
Florence, Covington, Fort Thomas, Newport, Fort Mitchell, Erlanger, Edgewood, and Independence, Kentucky.
